$comment: Index of pythonchain example chain manifests. Most chains are 4-7 atomic beads — each FilterBundle is one positive triple constraint, each PivotBundle one type-walk. The chain's identity rebinds to ?pN at each pivot bead so the tile renderer auto-switches displayed entity-type as the chain walks. Closed-world negation is avoided — no MINUS / NOT EXISTS / Difference (see docs/kgx/shared-components.md). Most chains fire at qlever.dev/api/wikidata.

examples.blurb: Five atomic filters narrow to Tory MPs of the 2024 cohort; three pivots walk alma maters → cities → countries.

examples.label: UK Labour MPs 2024 (fused execution)
